title: Spectral Turán Problems for Expanded hypergraphs
summary: Given a graph $F$, the expansion $F^{(r)}$ of $F$ is defined as the $r$-uniform hypergraph obtained from $F$ by adding a set of $(r-2)$ distinct new vertices to each edge of $F$. In this paper, we investigate spectral stability results for hypergraphs and their applications.We first establish a spectral stability property: for any $r$-uniform hypergraph containing no copy of the expansion $F^{(r)}$ of a $(k+1)$-chromatic graph $F$, if its $p$-spectral is close to the extremal value, then the hypergraph is structurally close to $T_r(n, k)$, the complete $k$-partite $r$-uniform hypergraph on…
